ayahs.en: The Inevitable Reality
ayahs.e2: The Inevitable Hour

ayahs.en: What is the Inevitable Reality
ayahs.e2: What is the Inevitable Hour

ayahs.en: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality
ayahs.e2: And what will make you realize what the Inevitable Hour is

ayahs.en: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity
ayahs.e2: ˹Both˺ Thamûd and ’Ȃd denied the Striking Disaster

ayahs.en: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast]
ayahs.e2: As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by an overwhelming blast

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا عَادࣱ فَأُهۡلِكُواْ بِرِيحࣲ صَرۡصَرٍ عَاتِيَةࣲ
ayahs.en: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
ayahs.e2: And as for ’Ȃd, they were destroyed by a furious, bitter wind
ayahs.tr: Wa ammaa 'Aadun fa uhlikoo bireehin sarsarin 'aatiyah

ayahs.ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَبۡعَ لَيَالࣲ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومࣰ اۖ فَتَرَى ٱلۡقَوۡمَ فِيهَا صَرۡعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمۡ أَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ خَاوِيَةࣲ
ayahs.en: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees
ayahs.e2: which Allah unleashed on them non-stop for seven nights and eight days, so that you would have seen its people lying dead like trunks of uprooted palm trees
ayahs.tr: Sakhkharahaa 'alaihim sab'a la yaalinw wa samaaniyata ayyaamin husooman fataral qawma feehaa sar'aa ka annahum a'jaazu nakhlin khaawiyah

ayahs.en: Then do you see of them any remains
ayahs.e2: Do you see any of them left alive

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَمَن قَبۡلَهُۥ وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلۡخَاطِئَةِ
ayahs.en: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin
ayahs.e2: Also, Pharaoh and those before him, and ˹the people of˺ the overturned cities ˹of Lot˺ indulged in sin
ayahs.tr: Wa jaaa'a Firawnu wa man qablahoo wal mu'tafikaatu bilhaati'ah

ayahs.ar: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةࣰ رَّابِيَةً
ayahs.en: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity]
ayahs.e2: each disobeying their Lord’s messenger, so He seized them with a crushing grip
ayahs.tr: Fa'ansaw Rasoola Rabbihim fa akhazahum akhzatar raabiyah

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلۡمَآءُ حَمَلۡنَٰكُمۡ فِي ٱلۡجَارِيَةِ
ayahs.en: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
ayahs.e2: Indeed, when the floodwater had overflowed, We carried you in the floating Ark ˹with Noah˺
ayahs.tr: Innaa lammaa taghal maaa'u hamalnaakum fil jaariyah

ayahs.ar: لِنَجۡعَلَهَا لَكُمۡ تَذۡكِرَةࣰ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنࣱ وَٰعِيَةࣱ
ayahs.en: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it
ayahs.e2: so that We may make this a reminder to you, and that attentive ears may grasp it
ayahs.tr: Linaj'alahaa lakum tazki ratanw-wa ta'iyahaa unzununw waa'iyah

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ نَفۡخَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ
ayahs.en: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
ayahs.e2: At last, when the Trumpet will be blown with one blast
ayahs.tr: Fa izaa nufikha fis soori nafkhatunw waahidah

ayahs.ar: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَٱلۡجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ
ayahs.en: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow
ayahs.e2: and the earth and mountains will be lifted up and crushed with one blow
ayahs.tr: Wa humilatil ardu wal jibaalu fadukkataa dakkatanw waahidah

ayahs.en: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur
ayahs.e2: on that Day the Inevitable Event will have come to pass

ayahs.en: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm
ayahs.e2: The sky will then be so torn that it will be frail

ayahs.ar: وَٱلۡمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرۡجَآئِهَاۚ وَيَحۡمِلُ عَرۡشَ رَبِّكَ فَوۡقَهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ ثَمَٰنِيَةࣱ
ayahs.en: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them]
ayahs.e2: with the angels on its sides. On that Day eight ˹mighty angels˺ will bear the Throne of your Lord above them
ayahs.tr: Wal malaku 'alaaa arjaaa'ihaa; wa yahmilu 'Arsha Rabbika fawqahum yawma'izin samaaniyah

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ تُعۡرَضُونَ لَا تَخۡفَىٰ مِنكُمۡ خَافِيَةࣱ
ayahs.en: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed
ayahs.e2: You will then be presented ˹before Him for judgment˺, and none of your secrets will stay hidden
ayahs.tr: Yawma'izin tu'radoona laa takhfaa min kum khaafiyah

ayahs.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
ayahs.en: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record
ayahs.e2: As for those given their records in their right hand, they will cry ˹happily˺, “Here ˹everyone˺! Read my record
ayahs.tr: Fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenihee fa yaqoolu haaa'umuq ra'oo kitaabiyah

ayahs.en: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account
ayahs.e2: I surely knew I would face my reckoning.”

ayahs.en: So he will be in a pleasant life
ayahs.e2: They will be in a life of bliss

ayahs.en: In an elevated garden
ayahs.e2: in an elevated Garden

ayahs.en: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near
ayahs.e2: whose fruit will hang within reach

ayahs.ar: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسۡلَفۡتُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأَيَّامِ ٱلۡخَالِيَةِ
ayahs.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past
ayahs.e2: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did in the days gone by.”
ayahs.tr: Kuloo washraboo haneee'am bimaaa aslaftum fil ayyaamil khaliyah

ayahs.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيۡتَنِي لَمۡ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
ayahs.en: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
ayahs.e2: And as for those given their record in their left hand, they will cry ˹bitterly˺, “I wish I had not been given my record
ayahs.tr: Wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo bishimaalihee fa yaqoolu yaalaitanee lam oota kitaaabiyah

ayahs.en: And had not known what is my account
ayahs.e2: nor known anything of my reckoning

ayahs.en: I wish my death had been the decisive one
ayahs.e2: I wish death was the end

ayahs.en: My wealth has not availed me
ayahs.e2: My wealth has not benefited me

ayahs.en: Gone from me is my authority
ayahs.e2: My authority has been stripped from me.”

ayahs.en: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him
ayahs.e2: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize and shackle them

ayahs.en: Then into Hellfire drive him
ayahs.e2: then burn them in Hell

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ فِي سِلۡسِلَةࣲ ذَرۡعُهَا سَبۡعُونَ ذِرَاعࣰا فَٱسۡلُكُوهُ
ayahs.en: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him
ayahs.e2: then tie them up with chains seventy arms long
ayahs.tr: Summa fee silsilatin zar'uhaa sab'oona ziraa'an faslukooh

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
ayahs.en: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great
ayahs.e2: For they never had faith in Allah, the Greatest

ayahs.en: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor
ayahs.e2: nor encouraged the feeding of the poor

ayahs.en: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
ayahs.e2: So this Day they will have no close friend here

ayahs.en: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds
ayahs.e2: nor any food except ˹oozing˺ pus
ayahs.tr: Wa laa ta'aamun illaa min ghisleen

ayahs.en: None will eat it except the sinners
ayahs.e2: which none will eat except the evildoers.”

ayahs.en: So I swear by what you see
ayahs.e2: Now, I do swear by whatever you see

ayahs.en: And what you do not see
ayahs.e2: and whatever you cannot see

ayahs.en: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger
ayahs.e2: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the recitation of a noble Messenger

ayahs.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوۡلِ شَاعِرࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰا مَّا تُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe
ayahs.e2: It is not the prose of a poet ˹as you claim˺, ˹yet˺ you hardly have any faith
ayahs.tr: Wa ma huwa biqawli shaa'ir; qaleelam maa tu'minoon

ayahs.ar: وَلَا بِقَوۡلِ كَاهِنࣲۚ قَلِيلࣰا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.en: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember
ayahs.e2: Nor is it the mumbling of a fortune-teller, ˹yet˺ you are hardly mindful
ayahs.tr: Wa laa biqawli kaahin; qaleelam maa tazakkaroon

ayahs.en: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.e2: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds

ayahs.en: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings
ayahs.e2: Had the Messenger made up something in Our Name

ayahs.en: We would have seized him by the right hand
ayahs.e2: We would have certainly seized him by his right hand

ayahs.en: Then We would have cut from him the aorta
ayahs.e2: then severed his aorta

ayahs.ar: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٍ عَنۡهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
ayahs.en: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him
ayahs.e2: and none of you could have shielded him ˹from Us˺

ayahs.en: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous
ayahs.e2: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder to those mindful ˹of Allah˺

ayahs.en: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers
ayahs.e2: And We certainly know that some of you will persist in denial
ayahs.tr: Wa inna lana'lamu anna minkum mukazzibeen

ayahs.en: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers
ayahs.e2: and it will surely be a source of regret for the disbelievers

ayahs.en: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty
ayahs.e2: And indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the absolute truth

ayahs.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great
ayahs.e2: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest
